scenario: Optional routine service revisit reminder for fictional OEM owners

eligibility.rule: Consent AND routine service due in 30 days AND no existing booking AND no mandatory safety notice

assignment.H: No optional marketing reminder; mandatory safety notices are outside the experiment

primary.denominator: all eligible assigned customers by original arm
primary.method: pooled two-sided z test with Bonferroni and Newcombe-Wilson difference interval

decision.rule: Message winner and rollout approval are separate; do not approve rollout if business value, optout safety or service capacity is unresolved
